title: Audio MultiChallenge: A Multi-Turn Evaluation of Spoken Dialogue Systems on Natural Human Interaction
authors_zh: Advait Gosai、Tyler Vuong、Utkarsh Tyagi、Steven Li、Wenjia You、Miheer Bavare、Arda Uçar、Zhongwang Fang、Brian Jang、Bing Liu、Yunzhong He

one_line: Audio MultiChallenge evaluates spoken dialogue systems on natural multi-turn interaction, including audio-native memory and voice editing.
以自然人声中的记忆、约束保持、自洽与语音编辑检验端到端语音对话系统。
why: Audio MultiChallenge evaluates spoken dialogue systems on natural multi-turn interaction, including audio-native memory and voice editing.
inclusion_reason: 以自然人声中的记忆、约束保持、自洽与语音编辑检验端到端语音对话系统。

title: Problem
问题
html: End-to-end spoken-dialogue models increasingly process raw audio directly, yet existing evaluations often use synthetic speech, single-turn questions, or transcripts. They therefore miss pauses, repairs, ambient sounds, and long-range conversational memory. The paper asks how to build a natural, multi-turn, finely gradable audio benchmark that tests semantic and acoustic memory, instruction retention, self-coherence, and the ability to follow mid-utterance corrections or backtracking.
端到端语音对话模型越来越多地直接处理原始音频，但现有评测常使用合成语音、单轮问答或转写文本，无法检验真实对话中的停顿、回改、环境声音和跨轮记忆。论文研究如何构造自然、多轮且可细粒度判分的音频 benchmark，测试模型是否能记住语义与声学线索、持续遵守指令、保持自洽，并理解说话者在句中撤回或修改的内容。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Audio MultiChallenge extends the text-based MultiChallenge framework into an audio-native setting. It retains Inference Memory, Instruction Retention, and Self Coherence while adding Voice Editing. The benchmark contains 452 conversations from 47 speakers and 1,712 instance-specific rubrics, preserving natural mistakes, pauses, non-monotonic phrasing, and background audio. Each task is judged with concrete, checkable requirements rather than a single holistic score.

Audio MultiChallenge 把文本版 MultiChallenge 扩展到音频原生场景，保留 Inference Memory、Instruction Retention 和 Self Coherence，并新增 Voice Editing。数据包含 452 段对话、47 位说话者和 1,712 条实例级 rubric，音频保留自然口误、停顿、非单调表述及背景声。每条任务不只给整体分数，而是用具体可检查标准判断模型是否满足关键要求。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define capability axes: Multi-turn failures are separated into memory, instruction retention, self-coherence, and spoken repairs, with audio-specific cue tasks added.
  2. Generate blueprints: An agentic pipeline proposes conversation goals, hidden dependencies, and instance-level rubrics designed to expose model failures.
  3. Record human speech: Forty-seven speakers perform natural interactions, preserving mistakes, corrections, prosody, and ambient sounds rather than relying on uniform text-to-speech.
  4. Human review: Annotators verify naturalness, task determinacy, and rubric coverage, revising ambiguous instances.
  5. Evaluate models: Systems receive the raw audio history and generate responses, which are checked item by item by rubric-based judges and aggregated by capability axis.

1. 设计能力轴：将多轮对话失败分为记忆、指令保持、自洽和语音回改，并为音频线索设计专门任务。
  2. 生成蓝图：代理流程先构造能诱发模型失败的对话目标、隐含依赖和实例级 rubric。
  3. 真人录制：由 47 位说话者完成自然交互，保留口误、纠正、语气和环境声音，而非统一文本转语音。
  4. 人工复核：标注者检查对话自然度、任务可判定性和 rubric 是否覆盖预期行为，修订含歧义实例。
  5. 模型评测：模型直接接收音频历史并生成回答，由 rubric judge 逐项判定，通过率按能力轴聚合。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors evaluate proprietary and open spoken-dialogue systems, and the strongest model, Gemini 3 Pro Preview (Thinking), reaches only a 54.65% pass rate. Voice Editing and Audio-Cue memory—where relevant information exists only in the acoustic signal—are particularly difficult, while self-coherence degrades with longer audio context. Human speech and instance-specific rubrics improve realism and interpretability, although automated rubric judging can still make errors and does not replace full human review.
作者评测多种闭源与开源语音模型，最强系统 Gemini 3 Pro Preview（Thinking）的总体通过率仍只有 54.65%。错误分析显示，Voice Editing 与仅存在于声学信号中的 Audio-Cue 记忆最困难，自洽性还会随音频上下文增长而下降。真人语音和实例级 rubric 增强了现实性与可解释性，但自动 judge 自身仍可能产生误判，论文结果不能完全替代逐条人工复核。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Audio benchmarks typically measure ASR, classification, or single-turn understanding, while text-based multi-turn benchmarks discard acoustic information. This work treats spoken editing as a distinct capability and introduces memory tasks solvable only through background sounds, prosody, or nonverbal cues. Rubric judging itself is not new; the novelty lies in combining audio-native multi-turn failure modes, naturally disfluent human speech, and instance-specific evaluation contracts.
语音 benchmark 通常测 ASR、音频分类或单轮理解；文本多轮 benchmark 又会丢失声学线索。该论文的关键变化是把“自然语音修改”作为独立能力，并设计只能依赖背景声、语调或非语言线索完成的记忆任务。使用 rubric judge 并不新，新意在于音频原生的多轮失败模式、真人非流畅语音和实例级评价契约的结合。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Language coverage: The benchmark is primarily English, so repair, pragmatic, and disfluency patterns may not transfer to other languages.
  2. Speaker scale: Forty-seven speakers provide natural variation but cannot represent the full distribution of accents, ages, and acoustic environments.
  3. Judge error: Open-ended answers are graded by rubric evaluators; incomplete rubrics or judges that overlook audio evidence can distort rankings.

1. 语言覆盖：当前数据主要是英语，口误、语用和回改模式可能无法迁移到其他语言。
  2. 说话者规模：47 位说话者能提供自然差异，但不足以代表口音、年龄和声学环境的完整分布。
  3. judge 误差：开放式回答由 rubric evaluator 判定，若 rubric 不完备或裁判忽视音频证据，会扭曲模型排名。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The benchmark can evaluate voice assistants, end-to-end speech-to-speech systems, and audio-input dialogue models while localizing failures by capability axis. Its conversations, acoustic cues, and rubrics can also train audio judges or support targeted data generation. Systems that transcribe before reasoning should report transcript-only and raw-audio results separately so gains are not incorrectly attributed to acoustic understanding.
该 benchmark 可用于评测语音助手、端到端 speech-to-speech 模型和带音频输入的对话模型，并按能力轴定位失败来源。数据中的对话、音频线索和 rubric 也可用于训练音频 judge 或生成有针对性的改进数据。若模型先转写再推理，应单独报告 transcript-only 与 raw-audio 结果，否则无法判断提升来自语言模型还是声学理解。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence positioning: A rubric-based benchmark for realistic multi-turn spoken interaction rather than ordinary ASR.
  2. Method takeaway: Agents generate task blueprints, humans record conversations, annotators review them, and instance-level rubrics grade responses.
  3. Data takeaway: It contains 452 conversations, 47 speakers, and 1,712 rubrics across four capability axes.
  4. Evidence anchor: The strongest tested model achieves about 54.65%, with spoken repairs and acoustic-cue memory being hardest.
  5. Reuse decision: It is suitable for diagnosing voice agents, but judge use of audio evidence must be audited.

1. 一句话定位：面向真实多轮语音交互的 rubric benchmark，而非普通 ASR 测试。
  2. 方法抓手：代理生成任务蓝图、真人录音、人工复核，再以实例级 rubric 判分。
  3. 数据抓手：452 段对话、47 位说话者、1,712 条 rubric，覆盖四个能力轴。
  4. 证据锚点：最强被测模型通过率约 54.65%，语音回改和声学线索记忆最困难。
  5. 复用决定：适合语音智能体诊断；必须审计 judge 是否真正使用音频证据。
